summary: A standing 100-ft Aermotor lookout in Cove Creek WMA, Campbell County; its stairs are gone and no road reaches it, so it is not one to climb.

facts.status_note: TNLandForms.us, an independent lookout site (revised January 8, 2026), shows it standing; NHLR visit reports from 2009 and 2015 describe the stairs removed and the tower in need of restoration

access.note: No stairs left and no road to the tower, per NHLR visit reports; the register does not say whether the land is public or private. The WMA itself is open year-round during daylight hours.

visit.trail_note: No road currently goes to the tower; a former road runs right beside it

events.note: NHLR visit by Michael Spanjer, November 23, 2009: stairs removed most of the way up; vines growing on the structure
Registered January 3, 2015; nominated by Michael Spanjer
NHLR visit by Christopher Covert, October 5, 2015: no stairs left; cab looks good with a wooden floor, condition unknown

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, purpose or fire history found in NHLR, TNLandForms or TWRA; two searches returned nothing on this tower. The brief's access 'unknown' is now restricted, based on the 2015 visit (no stairs, no road). height_m is the register's 100 ft converted; the register does not say whether that is tower height. Elevation: NHLR gives 1,432 ft, TNLandForms 1450'; the NHLR figure is used. Staffing as_of is the 2015 visit. Not verified on the ground. TNLandForms.us is an independent site (its footer credits an individual), not a state list; the story no longer calls it one.
